title: InvoiceOps Evaluation Result
description: One scored row per case per method, produced by the Day 4 evaluation harness. Scoring follows the dataset's EVALUATION_RUBRIC.md (decision 40%, extraction 30%, issue detection 20%, reasoning 10%).

field_extraction_score.description: Average over required fields: exact=1.0, close=0.7, incorrect=0.0, missing=0.0.

critical_failure.description: True when a high-severity REVIEW case was decided PASS (CASE-005/006/012). A critical failure fails the entire evaluation run regardless of score.
